decisionsTitle: The feedback page's title loses «(anonim)», and the featured card loses its chip
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-16, two screenshots.** On «Spune-ne ceva (anonim)»: «În momentul care selectez aici „Cu nume și prenume” deja titlul de (anonim) nu prea mai are sens». On the listing's lead card, with its thick primary border and the chips «★ Alergarea principală», «Concurs», «Ediție specială»: «când am „alergarea principală” nu vreau și încă un cip, îmi e suficient acel border».

**Decision, the title (amends §676).** `Tell.title`, the h1 of the form's page and the heading of its door on `/contact`, is «Spune-ne ceva» / "Tell us something" in both catalogues, the suffix gone. It was a promise the page could not keep: the radios beneath it let a person give a name, and a title that says anonymous then contradicts the choice. The reassurance lives where the choice is, in the radios' own «Anonim — Nu ne spui cine ești.» and «Cu nume și prenume — Ca să te putem căuta și să-ți răspundem.», unchanged. The first step's intro said «Anonim, dacă nu alegi să-ți spui numele.», which repeated the word the title lost; it now reads «Poți scrie anonim sau cu numele tău. Alege despre ce e vorba.» / "You can write anonymously or with your name. Choose what it is about." `Tell.noticeName`, the name the privacy notice's `{{feedbackForms}}` becomes, was already the title without the suffix (§699) and is unchanged, so an approved notice keeps matching. The email's first line «Nume: (anonim)» (§678) is a different thing — what the message says about its sender — and is unchanged.

**Decision, the chip (amends §470).** The featured card keeps its frame (`featuredCard`: the primary border, its ring and the gradient) and is no longer given the «Alergarea principală» chip: the border says it to the eye and the owner asked for nothing beside it. The accessible mark stays, as visually hidden words inside the title's link («Alergarea principală:» then the title), not an `aria-label` on the card: a label on a list item is poorly supported, and the card's region is named by that heading (`aria-labelledby`), so it is announced with the region as well. The hiding is a clip rule (`CARD_SR_ONLY_SX`), never `display: none`. The other chips keep their order and a card that is not the lead is unchanged. The Administrator's tick on the event editor is untouched, and the design page's «marks» row no longer draws a chip the cards do not wear. The star glyph `featured` left the public glyph table (no public file draws it any more; `tests/unit/design/status-chip.test.ts` holds that table to the public surface) and became `cover` in the backoffice's `STATUS_GLYPHS`, drawn by the shop editor's first-picture chip through `StatusChip`, the same star and the same test id.

**Refused:** keeping «(anonim)» on the contact page's heading while the wizard's lost it (one key, one name); a tooltip or a second visible mark for the lead; hiding the words with `display: none`, which removes them from the screen reader too.
changelogLine: - **The feedback page is «Spune-ne ceva», and the lead card has no chip** — the title no longer says «(anonim)» above the choice to give a name, and the featured event keeps its border without a second «Alergarea principală» chip (the words stay for a screen reader). §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 55: the contact page's section heading and the wizard's title read «Spune-ne ceva» / "Tell us something", without «(anonim)» / «(anonymous)»; the intro of the first step says one may write anonymously or with a name, and the identity radios (unchanged) carry the reassurance (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 50 and 72: the featured event's card draws no «Alergarea principală» / «Featured event» chip, its frame (border, ring, background) stays, and the words are visually hidden inside its title's link, so the region named by the title is announced with them; every other chip keeps its order and a card that is not the lead is unchanged (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the feedback page's title without «(anonim)»; the featured card keeps its border and loses its chip
